name: Oasis Day Camp Dobbs Ferry
description_short: A day camp on the Mercy University campus in Dobbs Ferry for ages 3 to 15, with an early childhood program for pre K and kindergarten, a day camp for grades 1 to 6 and teen travel camps for grades 5 to 10. Days mix swim lessons in the campus outdoor pool, sports, gardening, martial arts, drama in a university theater and STEM in a computer lab.
swim_waterfront_notes: Instructional swim and supervised free swim at Mercy University's private outdoor pool, taught by certified instructors and included in tuition.
notes: Camp runs 9 to 4:30 with free extended hours from 8 am to 6 pm, a hot lunch and snacks included. Closed Monday July 5, 2027. Also offers junior teen travel (grades 5 and 6), teen travel (grades 7 to 10) and a CIT program. Operated by Oasis, which runs camps in Brooklyn, Manhattan and Long Island.
